jobs.occupation: Student Software Tester for Digital Asset-Integrity Solutions, Brøndby
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy understanding how complex software and hardware works and spotting opportunities for improvement?

We are looking for a Software Tester to support end-user testing of our ultrasonic inspection software, P-Scan.

In this role, you will work closely with our software development team and play an important part in ensuring that new features and improvements meet quality and usability expectations before being delivered to customers.

About the role and key responsibilities

You will join DAIS, a dynamic business unit with approximately 50 employees, delivering innovative digital products and services - primarily to the wind industry, but also to nuclear, oil & gas, and space sectors. Our solutions help ensure product quality and operational excellence for our customers.

Your primary responsibility will be to perform structured end‑user tests based on real‑life usage scenarios. You will report findings, bugs, and improvement suggestions to the development team and assist in validating fixes. During your onboarding period, you will receive guidance and training from experienced colleagues.

Over time, you will become familiar with the software workflows and contribute actively to improving the overall user experience and reliability of the product.

The position is based at our headquarters in Brøndby and you will report to Søren K. Hansen, Senior Team Leader, Digital Asset-Integrity Solutions.

We are looking for a student who is interested in developing their skills with us over a longer period. In return, we offer a student position with the opportunity to stay and grow in the role throughout your studies.

Later in your time with us, there may also be an opportunity to develop the position into an engineering internship project that we define together.

We welcome applications from both Danish- and English-speaking candidates.

Additional information

You likely have:

• A solid ability to understand and work with technical solutions and software systems

• The willingness and ability to work on your own after an onboarding period

• Good analytical skills and attention to detail

• The ability to communicate findings clearly to developers and other stakeholders, both verbally and in writing

• Proficiency in English, as bug reports are submitted in English

It would be an advantage if you have

• Basic knowledge of C# programming

• Experience with software testing, quality assurance or technical products

However, these qualifications are not required, and we welcome applicants from a variety of technical backgrounds.

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

Does this sound like something for you?

If you think this job is for you, send us your application today. We process applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interview along the way. Please note that we only accept electronic applications via our recruitment system.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Søren K. Hansen on skh@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

Force Technology

At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

Build intelligent financial products. Solve real problems. Shape a company.

For our client Verifi Finance in central Copenhagen, we’re looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Software Engineer who combines exceptional engineering skills with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to solve meaningful customer problems.

At Verifi Finance, they believe great software starts with understanding the problem, not writing the code. They are building an AI-native platform that transforms complex, manual accounting workflows into reliable, intelligent automation — helping finance teams spend less time validating data and more time creating value.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply pick up tickets and implement predefined solutions. You’ll work closely with their founders and customers to uncover problems worth solving, challenge assumptions, shape the product, and take ideas from concept to production.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, build across the stack, experiment with emerging AI capabilities, and help define how they build and scale the company

Verifi Finance has solid funding and excisting customers in Denmark and Sweden with plans to expand across Europe soon.

See more here: verifi.finance

The Challenge (What you will build)

You will dive deep into the day-to-day chaos of accounting workflows, extract the logic, and write software that automates, validates, and quality-controls financial data.

• The “Hardcore” Logic:

You will translate messy, human-centric accounting processes into strict, “hardcore” business logic. This requires understanding the why behind a transaction, not just the how.

• Data Ingestion (Intelligent Document Processing):

You will build pipelines that ingest raw financial documents, cleaning and structuring that data for their system.

• LLM & Predictive Integration:

You will build AI agents that don’t just “chat”, but take real-world actions and amaze users to their core.

• Workflow Automation:

You will identify bottlenecks in Verifi Finance’s customers’ daily lives and code them out of existence.

• UI:

You will not shy away from contributing to UX and state management (client side) of the product.

The Verifi Finance Tech Stack

• Core: TypeScript (Must be god-level). They value type safety and strict standards.

• Data: Deep understanding of Databases. You know how to model financial ledgers and ensure data integrity.

• AI-Assisted Workflow: At Verifi, they move fast. They expect you to be proficient with Cursor, Claude, and Gemini to accelerate boilerplate and refactoring. They’d love to see how you do it your way.

• The “Plus” List: Experience with Python, Go, Rust, or Java is highly valued for backend performance and data processing_.

Who You Are

• Direct & Energetic: You cut through the noise. You communicate clearly, you push back when the design is wrong, and you bring energy to the team.

• Customer-Obsessed: You are willing to understand the “boring” parts of accounting to build the exciting parts of the software. You empathize with the user’s pain.

• A “Finisher”: You don’t just start cool experiments; you ship production-ready, test-covered features.

• Adaptable: Verifi Finance is well funded and ready to roll. The environment changes, the vision evolves, and you need to be quick to absorb new knowledge.

• Startup Mindset: Previous experience working in a startup environment is a strong plus.

Verifi Finance Offers You

• A unique opportunity to contribute to building a breakthrough financial software system

• Close collaboration with the founders and a team of dedicated colleagues

• Hybrid workplace with expected 2-3 workdays per week at the office

• A dynamic work environment with short decision-making paths

• Strong opportunities for personal development and expanded responsibilities

• Competitive salary and benefits package. They have an ESOP in place and this role is planned to be a part of it with standard cliff periods.

You will work at the company HQ in central Copenhagen, offering lunch facilities and access to a vibrant startup ecosystem.

Interested in joining Verifi Finance?

At Bloom, we are actively reviewing applications and look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk or +45 2086 0865.

The Tech Collective, Data & AI

Kalkværksvej 5, 8000 Aarhus · Full-time

We’re looking for a senior builder who turns AI and data into products people actually use. You’ve shipped real systems end to end, you know AI or data well enough to make it work in production, not just in a demo, and AI is as much a part of how you build as what you build.

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll take client ideas from a rough hypothesis to a working prototype, and then to a production system that runs reliably. You'll design the architecture, write the code across frontend, backend, and data, and decide what to build and what to leave out. It's a hands-on role. Most of your time goes into building, and the rest goes into working with clients to make sure you’re building the right thing.

The work covers generative AI applications and agents, including the harnesses that make them reliable (tools, context, memory, orchestration, and guardrails), along with retrieval pipelines and the data flows they depend on. You’ll connect these to client systems, deploy them in the cloud, and set up the evals and observability you need to see whether they work and how to improve them. You’ll work closely with our data platform and AI specialists, review code, and help less experienced engineers grow.

What you'll bring

You're a builder at heart. You have a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, (preferably) 5+ years of hands-on software experience, and a track record of shipping production-ready software systems. Ideally, you also have experience with the whole software development lifecycle: starting with an idea (whether your own or a stakeholder’s), designing the solution architecture, developing and testing the solution, and putting it into the hands of actual users. Good engineering matters to you, but you’re not a purist, you care more about shipping something that works and solves the problem.

What sets you apart is depth beyond the code. You know AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, evals) and data (data modelling, pipelines, event-driven, and real-time systems) well enough that others come to you for it. Ideally, you know a bit of both.

You're equally at home building AI products and building with AI. Coding agents and AI-assisted tools are part of how you work every day, and you use them critically. You know where they make you faster and where the output needs a careful human eye.

To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• 
Solid full-stack skills in Python and/or TypeScript (e.g., React, Next.js, FastAPI), with production systems to show for it

• 
Hands-on experience building agents and the harnesses around them (tool use, MCP, context and memory management, orchestration, guardrails), and designing the data models and pipelines that real products run on

• 
An AI-native way of working, using coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex in your own development workflow, with a clear view of where they help and where they don’t

• 
Experience deploying and running solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers, CI/CD, and enough observability to know what's going on

• 
System-level judgement: you can reason about architecture, trade-offs, and failure modes, and you can spot the weak points in an existing stack

• 
Curiosity about the client’s problem, and the ability to explain technical choices clearly to people who don’t write code

• 
A habit of helping others get better through sparring, pairing, and code reviews

English is our corporate language. Proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus.

What we offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll join a team of 30 consultants that feels closer to a nerdy startup than a large consultancy, while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll have the freedom to shape your role in the direction that motivates you.

You’ll work on data and AI problems across industries, alongside experienced peers in AI, data, and software. Our culture is built on trust, curiosity, humility, and impact, with high autonomy, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing.

Ready to build with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the potential of data, AI, and analytics so they’re fit for the digital future. In our collective, you’ll find people who combine nerdiness with infectious energy. We’re passionate about technology, and we have a sincere interest in people

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor at the Department of Public Health
jobs.description:
The Department of Public Health at the Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, invites applications for a full-time position as Associate Professor with a research and teaching profile in the area of complex interventions. The expected starting date is February 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a three-year position that expires on January 31st, 2030.

About the Department

The Department of Public Health is a research-intensive environment dedicated to advancing scientific knowledge and developing applied solutions to major public health challenges. Our research spans theoretical, basic, and applied sciences, with the shared ambition of generating impactful knowledge and improving population health. Academic excellence is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to conducting rigorous and innovative research and delivering high-quality teaching. We teach across public health, sport science, health science, nursing science, related methodological disciplines, and the medical degree programme.

Rooted in our respective disciplines, we foster interdisciplinary collaboration to strengthen research, education and innovation. We are equally committed to cultivating a healthy and supportive workplace characterised by open dialogue, mutual respect and an informal atmosphere. We believe that academic excellence and personal well-being are mutually reinforcing and essential to long-term success.

You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here**.

Your job responsibilities

As an Associate Professor of Public Health, you will contribute to the department’s research and teaching environment and to the faculty’s overall research strategy. You will contribute to the development of the department both individually and in collaboration with others via your research of high international quality. You ensure that your teaching maintains a high academic and didactic standard. You possess professional collaborative skills and a broad academic network which you are able to bring into play in your contribution to the academic development of Aarhus University and its profile both nationally and internationally.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Conducting and publishing research of high international quality, including in leading journals and with leading publishers within your field.

• Developing your research profile and contributing to the department's objectives, including raising research external funding for your research projects.

• Teaching and supervising students at Bachelor's and Master's level and contributing to the continued development of innovative teaching activities.

• Participating in the supervision of PhD students and contributing to the faculty's PhD courses.

• Disseminating research findings to academic audiences, stakeholders, and the wider public.

You will report to the Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitagaard.

Your competences

You have established yourself as a recognised researcher within your field and can document research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have a well-developed international network, experience in attracting significant external research funding from national and international funding bodies, and clear potential and motivation to establish yourself as a research leader, to establish your own research group, and to consolidate an independent research agenda. In the assessment process, emphasis will be placed on experience gained through employment, visiting appointments, or extended research stays at recognised universities or research institutions outside the candidate's primary institution.

Your personal qualities include the ability to build trust-based relationships with colleagues, students, and external partners. As a teacher, you communicate current and relevant knowledge in a clear, engaging, and inspiring manner. As a supervisor, you are professional, inclusive, and supportive. You value collaboration and contribute positively to the collegial culture that characterises the Department of Public Health, the Faculty of Health Sciences, and Aarhus University more broadly. You are motivated to contribute to the department's continued development and to help maintain an inclusive, supportive, and high-performing work environment.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish, and Aarhus University arranges Danish teaching.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Shortlisting will be applied as part of the assessment process.

Questions about the position

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard tel.: (+45) 4022 7649. Your place of work will be the Department of Public Health, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Terms of employment

• Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

• The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

• The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.

• Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

• Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Application

Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application

• Curriculum Vitae

• Diploma

• Template for applicant - associate professor

• A list of publications

• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

• The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted

• Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)

We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the potential of data, AI, and analytics so they’re fit for the digital future. In our collective, you’ll find people who combine nerdiness with infectious energy. We’re passionate about technology, and we have a sincere interest in people.

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Shape leadership at a company that shapes societies!

ABOUT US

For more than 50 years, KMD has built and operated digital infrastructure that citizens, governments, and businesses rely on from welfare and public administration to critical digital services.

As societies face demographic change, digital sovereignty, climate resilience, and technological disruption, we combine technology expertise with an understanding of society’s needs.

Our 2030 strategy and new cross-functional organization bring us closer to customers, combining domain expertise and technologies such as AI to create value for customers and society. We’re looking for an experienced Lead Learning & Development specialist to translate strategy into people initiatives and strengthen the employee experience across the People agenda.

About the Capability Management team

You will join our Capability Management team within the People (HR) department. We are accountable for onboarding, leadership and specialist development, strategic workforce planning, diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI), employee engagement, and performance management. We work closely with our lines of business and colleagues across People to translate business priorities into practical initiatives that build the capabilities KMD needs today and in the future.

ABOUT THE JOB

Working closely with business leaders and People teams, you will ensure our learning programs and offerings align with organizational goals, reinforce key competencies, and foster a thriving leadership culture. Your primary focus will be designing leadership development frameworks and taking end-to-end ownership of program implementation and delivery. Facilitation is a supporting part of the role, rather than its main focus.

Accountability and Key Responsibilities

Leadership development & frameworks

• 
Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of KMD’s leadership framework and principles, translating them into impactful learning offerings – from comprehensive development programs and focused learning sessions to bite-sized digital learning.

• 
Translate business strategy and cultural priorities into scalable leadership development programs and learning events for different leadership levels.

Program design & delivery

• 
Own the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of leadership development programs, translating frameworks into practical learning journeys and coordinating internal experts and external providers.

• 
Act as subject matter expert and advisor to leaders on leadership capability building.

Succession planning

• 
Own the succession planning framework and annual process in collaboration with HRBPs and business leaders.

• 
Ensure robust identification, assessment, and development of critical leadership talent and successors.

Assessment tools & development

• 
Lead the use and continuous improvement of Deeper Signals and Hogan to support individual and team development.

• 
Facilitate individual feedback sessions and team workshops, translating assessment insights into clear development actions.

Data, governance & impact

• 
Define success metrics for leadership development and succession planning.

• 
Use data and insights to continuously improve programs and ensure measurable impact.

You will work from our Ballerup office in reference to Head of Capability Management.

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications & Requirements

This role requires experience with end-to-end responsibility for designing, rolling out, and following up on leadership learning events and programs. Your core strength is designing leadership development frameworks and translating them into effective programs. You are experienced in defining clear learning objectives aligned with strategic goals and bring proven expertise in applying learning taxonomies to program design. We are looking for a framework architect and program owner, rather than primarily a facilitator.

• 
Over 5 years of experience in Learning & Development, with a strong emphasis on leadership development.

• 
Strong framework and learning design skills, combined with the ability to manage program delivery; facilitation, coaching, and communication skills support this work.

• 
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Ability to influence and build relationships across all levels of the cross-functional organization.

• 
Demonstrates empathy and emotional intelligence in interactions with learners and leaders.

• 
Relevant Master’s degree in HR, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field.

What we offer?

Join a collaborative, inclusive environment that values innovation and continuous learning, with opportunities to develop your expertise and help others grow.

Shape leadership development in a growing international company, turning frameworks into programs that strengthen our leadership culture and support business ambitions.

Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model that combines time with colleagues and working from home.

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes two to three interviews with the hiring team, two tests (a cognitive and a personality test), and a case presentation on leadership development. This gives us the opportunity to get to know each other and explore how your experience and approach match the role.

Interested?

If you’re ready to bring your full expertise to a role where the business wants People at the table, we’d love to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To learn more about the position, you’re welcome to contact Head of Capability Management, José Leonardo email: JRO@kmd.dk.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of offshore wind. As our Traverse Equipment Owner, you will serve as the technical authority and lifecycle owner for traverse equipment used in offshore installation and servicing operations. You will be responsible for ensuring equipment performance, reliability, safety, and long-term value across a global fleet.

Working at the intersection of engineering, operations, project execution, suppliers, and management, you will play a key role in aligning diverse stakeholder needs and translating them into clear requirements, priorities, and improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Own the traverse equipment lifecycle, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, safety, and long-term business value.

• Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, success criteria, and approved improvement initiatives.

• Develop and maintain the traverse equipment roadmap and prioritized backlog, including technology development and investment needs.

• Monitor fleet performance, assess incidents and lessons learned, and drive corrective actions, upgrades, and risk mitigation measures.

• Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and the adoption of innovative technologies across the Equipment organization.

What You Bring

• An Engineering degree (Mechanical, Marine, Civil, Industrial, or similar) and at least 10 years of technical experience in equipment development, maintenance, or asset management within offshore wind or a comparable heavy-industry environment.

• Proven experience with traverse systems, lifting equipment, stabilization systems, motion control technologies, or other equipment used for offshore heavy-load handling.

• Demonstrated experience in equipment ownership, technical leadership, or lifecycle management of complex engineered products.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

About the Team

You will join a global team responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of specialized offshore equipment. The team combines operational experience with engineering expertise to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency throughout its lifecycle. Together, we drive innovation, standardization, and best practices that support offshore wind projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

Join Vattenfall in enabling fossil-free living by securing the structural integrity and lifetime of offshore wind foundations across Europe. You do not need all the answers on day one; we value curiosity and offer strong mentorship to help you grow.

On behalf of Vattenfall, Academic Work is looking for one early-career engineer. We are open to candidates from different engineering disciplines – depending on your background, competencies, and personal interests, you will join one of the following three specialist teams:

• Primary Structures: Geotechnical and structural monopile design, optimization, and lifetime reassessment.

• Structural Loads: Multidisciplinary aeroelastic load simulations, structural dynamics, and applied AI/data analytics.

• Secondary Structures & CAD: Steel design, 3D modeling/CAD, structural calculations, and operational integrity.

Across all tracks, you will work on real deliverables alongside experienced colleagues in an international environment focused on psychological safety, modern digital tools, and technical sparring.

At Vattenfall, they foster a culture built on trust, well-being, and balance:

• Supportive community & mentorship: A thorough, safe onboarding alongside dedicated senior engineers and managers to ensure you receive technical sparring and the strongest possible career start.

• Inclusive environment: An open and informal culture where you can ask questions, challenge existing ways of working, learn from mistakes, and share ideas from day one.

• Flexibility with respect for your life: A 37-hour working week with core hours between 09:00–15:00 and flexible hybrid/home-office options, balancing presence at the office with everyday life.

Work tasks

In this role, you will be integrated directly into real offshore wind projects and operating assets from day one. You will work independently, but you will never face challenges alone - a dedicated senior engineer is always by your side for sparring and quality checks.

You will not cover all disciplines; your day-to-day responsibilities will be focused within your designated team:

• Primary Structures track:

• Design and optimization of monopile foundation structures across structural and geotechnical disciplines.

• Analyzing structural performance data from measurements and the running offshore fleet to support lifetime extensions.

• Structural Loads track:

• Aeroelastic load simulations and turbine dynamic response assessments using multidisciplinary simulation tools.

• Exploring and developing AI, machine learning, and automation workflows for engineering data.

• Secondary Structures & CAD track:

• Concept development, detailed steel design, 3D modeling, and technical drawings for secondary structures.

• Structural calculations (FEA or hand calculations) and operational technical support for offshore assets.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is a recent graduate or has up to approximately 1–2 years of post-graduation experience.

• Holds an engineering degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) within Structural, Civil, Mechanical, Offshore, or Wind Energy Engineering (or similar).

• Brings a solid theoretical foundation in at least one of the following areas:

• Structural steel design, geotechnical design, or finite element analysis (FEA).

• Aeroelasticity, fluid mechanics, hydrodynamics, or structural dynamics.

• Mechanical design, 3D CAD modeling, and technical drawing preparation.

• Has an analytical, structured mindset and a proactive problem-solving attitude.

• Possesses strong communication skills, an open personality, and a collaborative team-first approach.

• Speaks and writes fluent English (Vattenfall’s corporate language).

It is an advantage if you:

• Have an interest or demonstrated experience in data analysis, Python/programming, automation, or applied AI/machine learning.

• Have prior relevant experience from student jobs, internships, or thesis projects within renewable energy, offshore wind, or structural mechanics.

Our recruitment process

The recruitment process is managed by Academic Work, and it is our client's wish that all inquiries regarding the position are directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is ongoing, and the job posting may close before the recruitment process is completed if we advance to the next phase. The process includes two tests: a personality assessment and a cognitive test. These tests serve as tools to find the right talent for the right role and ensure equal opportunity, diversity, and a fair evaluation process.

Do You Feel a Match?

Even if you don't feel you check every single technical box, we still encourage you to apply! Both we at Academic Work and the team at Vattenfall value your potential, your curiosity, and your drive to learn just as much as your specific experience. We are looking for the right mindset and motivation to grow within offshore wind engineering.

VATTENFALL A/S

Vattenfall is one of Europe's largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Vattenfall’s main purpose is to enable fossil-free living within one generation. The company employs approximately 20,000 people and primarily operates in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Vattenfall works actively to build a more attractive and diverse workplace where all employees have equal rights and opportunities regardless of background, and where everyone's contribution is valued.
